notes.title: New patch!
notes.notes:
Hey! Thanks for playing DOODLE CHAMPS! 🎨✌

Mini Patch Notes:

 Chaos Mode: Fixed Chaos Orb's despawning permanently when spam clicked.
 Chaos Mode: Bird Poop animations tweaked
 Updated eyedropper tool to have a live colour indicator!
- Now you can see what colour your cursor will pick in real-time!
 Updated Bulletin Board

👉 Join our discord from the main menu! We're starting an arty-party community! Share your artwork and show off your doodle skills with like-minded Doodle Champs! 🎨✨

Thanks for playing the Doodle Champs Demo and for 1000+ Wishlists on Steam!
More updates to come soon, including further improvements to Chaos Mode, SFX, & more.

- AlexSquid

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS PREPERATION UPDATE!
notes.notes:
It's a BIG update!

Patch notes:

 - All game modes are fully playable.
 - Huge Pencil/Brush/Eraser optimizations.
 - SOUND EFFECTS added to the game! 
 - SFX added to Doodle Dash
 - SFX added to Medals/Awards
 - SFX added to Art Tools UI
 - You can now bump/draw against canvas edges without issues.
 - Huge eraser tool performance optimizations!
 - Canvas Crew and Art Assembly performance greatly optimized.
 - New Doodle Dash Overview screen
 - Fixed "grey outlines" bug
 - Fixed all known Canvas Crew bugs.
 - Fixed Pencil Pushers "Fry It" bug.
 - Fixed player still able to draw after pressing done in Pencil Pushers.
 - Fixed missing Art Assembly save feature
 - Fixed and improved saving feature.
 - Fixed a bug preventing players from "catching up" in menus if joining late.
 - Further optimized Pen Test Mode.
 - Player name alignment and sizing improvement.
 - Added disconnection UI for many disconnect scenarios.
 - Added Early Access preparation content
 - New bulletin board feature 
 - Bulletin board button added to Menu
 - Discord button added to Menu (Opens official playtest discord)

As you can see, we've been hard at work squashing every bug we find as we continue to optimize the game for as many tablets as possible. Our aim is to release the game to Steam's Early Access in Mid December 2024.

Once released, we'll gather crucial feedback from a large pool of tablet users, and continue making improvements to the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971378/24707b79cbeb64067ccfe6759a22fc60b2bde9ac.png

The road to 1.0 continues!
